anti_leakage.target_use: complete-case evaluation eligibility and outcome measurement only

configuration.aggregation: query census within transition; macro values weight six transitions equally
configuration.evaluation_universe: frozen-list complete case: query and all five selected peers must have W_{t+1} residuals; otherwise drop without reranking

frozen_blend.definition: 0.8*per-query average percentile rank(ReturnPath) + 0.2*per-query average percentile rank(TF-IDF)
frozen_blend.selection: weight selected on historical transitions only

outcomes.query_basket_correlation: sample correlation between W_{t+1} query residual and frozen equal-notional peer basket
outcomes.signed_peer_correlation: within-query mean of five W_{t+1} sample residual correlations

configuration.peer_basket: equal-notional arithmetic mean of five raw FF5 residual paths
configuration.random_negative_control: five samples without replacement from W_t selection universe; SHA-256-derived per-query seed based on base seed 20260730, feature-window label, and sorted-universe query index
configuration.return_path: cosine similarity of W_t standardized FF5 residual paths
configuration.score_tie_handling: scripts.metrics.top_k_indices with TIE_RNG_BASE=314159 and query_seed equal to sorted-universe query index
configuration.selection_universe: lexicographically sorted intersection of W_t complete-return universe and non-empty W_t vintage 10-K Item 1; W_{t+1} availability is not inspected
configuration.sic2: score 1 for same current two-digit SIC and 0 otherwise; canonical deterministic exact-tie jitter

tfidf.selection: configuration b selected on historical transitions only

limitations: Complete-case evaluation is method-specific because a frozen peer missing W_{t+1} returns causes that query-method pair to be dropped.
The equal-notional residual basket is an application diagnostic, not an investable hedge, return forecast, or profitability test.
The experiment inherits the paper's ex-post survivor/news-visible candidate cohort; removing target-availability leakage from each transition does not make the cohort a point-in-time live universe.
SIC codes come from the current candidate-universe snapshot and are a coarse practitioner baseline, not a historically vintaged taxonomy.
Six adjacent transitions are dependent; means and win counts are descriptive and no IID p-values are reported.
